text:
maria: quick sync — I'm rolling the prefetch/window + kernel perf patch. need owners, canary plan, and dep checks. tl;dr: prefetch window bump, continuous batching tweak, KV warmup + eviction changes. @jon @ravi @sara
jon: can you paste the PR? want to skim the kernel diffs.
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/426 — main changes are kernel loop vectorization + reduced batch timeout. also prefetch config at runtime.
ravi: quick question — does the KV warmup touch shard-local state? worried about eviction thrashing during canary.
maria: yes shard-local warmup added. eviction thresholds moved from 0.6 -> 0.75 for canary. short config snapshot:
```
prefetch_window: 128 -> 256
batch_timeout_ms: 3 -> 2
kv_warmup_shards: 8
kv_eviction_threshold: 0.75
```
sara: who is owner for the canary and rollback playbook if latency regresses?
maria: owners: kernel/Jon, prefetch/Ravi, canary+metrics/Sara. rollback plan: 1) disable prefetch flag 2) scale down kernel variant 3) fallback to model-variant-b. Doc in PR description.
jon: i'll own kernel CR reviews. pinged reviewers: @ing-kernel, @ing-runtime. also saw a flaky test 'kv-evict-test' locally — will open a fix PR if it repros on CI.
ravi: i'll run warmup harness against staging canary and point perf harness at the new kernel variant. command i'll run:
```
./tools/perf_harness --variant canary-326 --warmup true --qps 500
```
canary-bot: canary deploy started for runtime-canary-326 — tracking: https://ci.redwood.internal/canaries/326
sara: I'll watch latency SLOs + error budget in the dashboard. will post first 30m after canary starts, and will be oncall if something spikes. cc @ops on escalation.
maria: thanks — timeline: canary start now, 30m initial gating, 2h extended run if stable. please comment on PR for any infra/dependency gaps. tagging cross-team owners again: @jon @ravi @sara
jon: ack. i'll buffer a small revert patch in case we need emergency rollback.
sara: noted, running tests now — will report by EOD or earlier if noisy.
maria: awesome, appreciate it. :rocket:
